messages.subject: Senior Thailand and APAC profile | Country strategy, ESG and external affairs
messages.body:
Dear PERSOLKELLY Thailand Team,

I am reaching out for senior Thailand and APAC assignments where country strategy, external affairs, sustainability or government relations sit close to business leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ year career spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current mandate covers government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring direct operating experience across complex regulators, communities, strategic partners and technical teams. My recent work also includes renewable-energy stakeholder coordination and carbon-data governance.

I would value consideration for Director, Head, Country Representative, Country Director, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability and Strategic Partnerships searches across Thailand and the region. I have attached a PERSOLKELLY-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
